args.query:
-- compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel
WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT user_id, channel, MIN(active_date) AS first_date
  FROM fct_user_days
  WHERE is_internal = FALSE
  GROUP BY user_id, channel
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT channel, first_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM cohorts
  GROUP BY channel, first_date
),
retained AS (
  SELECT c.channel, c.first_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ud.user_id) AS retained_90
  FROM cohorts c
  JOIN fct_user_days ud
    ON ud.user_id = c.user_id
   AND ud.active_date = c.first_date + INTERVAL '90 day'
  WHERE ud.is_internal = FALSE
  GROUP BY c.channel, c.first_date
),
agg AS (
  SELECT cs.channel,
         SUM(cs.cohort_size) AS total_cohort,
         SUM(COALESCE(r.retained_90,0)) AS total_retained_90
  FROM cohort_sizes cs
  LEFT JOIN retained r
    ON cs.channel = r.channel AND cs.first_date = r.first_date
  WHERE cs.first_date >= DATE '2026-04-14' AND cs.first_date <= DATE '2026-07-12' - INTERVAL '90 day'
  GROUP BY cs.channel
)
SELECT channel, total_cohort, total_retained_90, 
       CASE WHEN total_cohort=0 THEN NULL ELSE total_retained_90::double/total_cohort END AS retention_90
FROM agg
ORDER BY retention_90 DESC;
